_comment: Per-aircraft overrides. First profile whose 'match' is a case-insensitive substring of the sim TITLE wins; no match = standard SimVars only. Only entries with confirmed=true replace the field; unconfirmed ones are recorded in 'raw' only. Confirm an L:var by flipping the switch both ways and seeing the value change.

profiles.name: iniBuilds A350
profiles._comment: Sign switches are 3-position, the other way round from the Fenix: 0 = ON, 1 = AUTO, 2 = OFF (confirmed 2026-11-18: all at 2 with the owner seeing OFF; flipped 2-1-0-1-2). seatbelts uses L:INI_SEATBELTS_ON, the sign the cabin actually sees (AUTO resolved by the aircraft; owner found it in dev mode: switch AUTO at the gate = 0). Same pairs exist for L:INI_NO_SMOKING_ON and L:INI_SIGNS_NO_MOBILE / L:INI_NO_PORTABLE_DEVICES_ON (no board field). Beacon, park brake, doors and lights read fine from the standard SimVars.
profiles._fuelUsed: Standard ENG FUEL FLOW SimVars read 0 on the A350. ffKgH = rate of change of the sum of these per-engine fuel-used counters (kg since engine start); checked 2026-11-27 in cruise: 8,750 kg/h, matching the FUEL TOTAL QUANTITY WEIGHT drop exactly.
